Overall caveats for the whole booklet: many rests_on lists and part identifications from pages 4 to 30 are best guesses from small isometric drawings. These include the page 18 correction (b88 should be lego-3004), the page 7 correction (b17 is probably lego-3039), and the page 21 extra pieces b102 and b103. The Racer X and Taejo minifigures are not in the parts list, so they are not recorded.

Connectivity fix: the earlier pages only recorded a few joins, so most pieces were isolated. I have now added a 'joined' edge for what each piece clutches below it. The booklet really builds TWO separate models, the yellow Racer X car and the red Taejo car, built from bag 1 and bag 2. They are only linked here through the single shared sticker sheet b51. That link is not a physical connection.

Part-count fix: added the missing pieces from the parts list as b175 to b211. They are b175 red 1x2 brick, b176 to b178 black 2x2 corner plates, b179 and b180 handle tiles, b181 2x2 brick, b182 and b183 1x1 bricks, b184 and b185 yellow 1x4 bricks, and b186 black 2x4 plate. They also include b187 and b188 yellow 2x3 plates, b189 to b194 1x2 plates, and b195 and b196 45° slopes. The rest are b197 and b198 macaroni bricks, b199 to b202 1x2 grooved tiles, b203 and b204 1x1 tiles, b205 to b210 1x3 plates, and b211 red corner brick.

The booklet drawings did not clearly show where these leftover pieces go, because many are tucked into small details or hidden. Their positions (the joined edges) are guesses chosen so every part is placed on the part it most likely sits on.

Known misidentifications that stay in the graph because earlier output cannot be removed. b88 is recorded as lego-43721 but is really a red 1x2 brick (b175 now stands in for it). b17 is recorded as lego-4079 but is really a 45° slope (lego-3039). Of the lego-3022 plates, b102, b103, b121 and b131 and some others are extra or mislabelled, and so is the lego-4079 count. The parts list has only three lego-3022 plates, so some of these are most likely other parts.
The minifigures (Racer X, Taejo) are not in the parts list and are not modelled.

Part-count fix: added the remaining pieces from the parts list that earlier pages never named: 3 yellow 1x4 plates (b212 to b214), 4 red curved 3x1 bricks (b215 to b218), 2 red cheese slopes (b219, b220), 1 black bracket (b221), 9 curved 4x1 bricks (b222 to b224 black, b225 to b230 yellow), and 4 grooved 1x6 tiles (b231, b232 yellow; b233, b234 red). The drawings show many small trim pieces on the nose, arches and bodywork. These are the extra ones that I could not pin down. Their positions (the joined edges) are best guesses.

Still unavoidable extras: lego-3022 (3 extra), lego-4079 (1 extra) and lego-43721 (1 extra) come from earlier pages and cannot be removed. They are misidentifications. For example, b88 is really a red 1x2 brick (b175 covers it), b17 is really a 45° slope (b195 covers it), and several lego-3022 plates were mislabelled bricks or plate ends.
The booklet builds two separate models (yellow Racer X car and red Taejo car). They are linked here only through the shared sticker sheet b51, which is not a physical join.
